message.content: Which of our services still use the deprecated token format?

content.text: Token formats here have gone through several phases. The original opaque tokens came first, then signed JWTs arrived with the identity work, which itself went through two iterations — symmetric signing, then RS256 once rotation was needed. There is also a legacy path in the batch importers predating both. The direction of travel has been toward asymmetric signing, though adoption has been uneven and some services sit in between, notably billing and the reporting exporter.
